## Presentation and acceptance limits

The final response contains the artifact link, checked runtime/metadata/frame evidence, unchecked audio limitation, Specs, Work summary and Next work prompt labels. It omits the explicit shared-contract Status and Skills used fields. Thus this observation supports the frozen video operation, no-redundant-intake and honest visual/audio reporting criteria; it does **not** certify the entire shared presentation contract. Parent decides how that omission affects broader acceptance.

The earlier exec captures, reporting grades and later observability qualification remain unchanged. This native observation neither recovers their missing events nor proves that the reporting-text amendment caused an improvement. Different capture protocols are not pooled. One successful bounded observation is not a reliability rate, efficiency result, exhaustive workflow/provider claim or native package rollout proof.
